---
title: "Survey with a CBC module"
greedyq:
  version: "0.3_2026-10-26_678e6bb"
  language: en
survey-settings:
  required: [experience, interest]
---

--- background
# A few questions before the choices

```{r}
sd_question(type = "numeric", id = "experience", label = "How many online courses have you tried?", min = 0, max = 100)
```

--- preferences
# Your usual preference

```{r}
sd_question(type = "mc", id = "format", label = "Which format do you usually prefer?", options = c("Text" = "text", "Video" = "video"))
```

--- course_choices
# Choose between course plans

```{r}
sd_cbc(name = "course_choices", design = "study.design.json")
```

--- impressions
# After the choices

```{r}
sd_question(type = "nps", id = "interest", label = "How interested are you in these plans?", min = 0, max = 10)
```

```{r}
sd_question(type = "textarea", id = "comment", label = "Any comments?")
```
